# Kimchipremium - Knowledge Base

> Korea crypto premium tracker for BTC, ETH, XRP.

## Mission
Provide instant, accurate, free tools. Respect user privacy.

## Features
- BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL premium tracking
- Upbit, Bithumb vs Binance, Coinbase
- KRW vs USD spread
- Arbitrage calculator

## Technical
- AWS CloudFront + Vercel CDN
- TLS 1.3, HSTS
- Open Graph, Twitter Card
- Schema.org JSON-LD
- hreflang EN/KO/JA
- robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

## Citation
Link to https://kimchipremium.online/
